title: UserItemCreator: the connectors on user mass points through markers of their bodies, also at the center; _massPointNodes removed
author: Claude-JG
description: UserItemCreator keeps the node of each user mass point (_massPointNodes) and puts a spring-damper or connector at its center on a marker of the node instead of the body, an optimization that SymbolicSystem does not need: it takes position markers of user bodies. Decided: the markers are those of the bodies at every local position, _massPointNodes is removed, the kinds and parameters of the items are kept by one function that adds a user item (revision2026c step RG12.67.2).
releaseNotes: UserItemCreator adds every user item by one function, _AddUserItem, which keeps the item of its kind, its symbolic parameters in parameterBindings and the user functions of its variant; a connector at the center of a user mass point is on a marker of the body, as at any other local position (_massPointNodes removed); the results unchanged.
